description: Show exactly what new permissions an agent gains after an update — added, removed, risky — before you approve it.
notes: Shared kit landed mid-build; re-targeted to the real shared/kit.js contract.

notes.note: Dependabot-for-permissions is a clever pitch but demand is hypothetical: agents don't auto-update at a frequency or with consequences that make this a budgeted line item yet. It's also an audit-trail feature of whoever runs the agent registry, not a standalone company. You'd need a supply-chain attack headline to create this market, and building on hoped-for headlines is a bad plan.
Permission rows expand with justification + risk; approve/block modal works; zero errors.

notes.change: Deploy-gate verdict: per-permission approve/restrict/block decisions persist per version pair; BLOCKED/PENDING/PASS banner computed from decisions; every button now changes real state.
